notes.title: Stranger danger
notes.content:
[i]20210711[/i]
What’s good, gamers? We’re honestly pretty surprised to admit how far a few flashing lights can go! Part of the incoming missile warning we had planned was to spice up the screen and inject a little more chaos to your eyeballs while providing information to help you race as effectively as possible. We feel like we succeeded wildly on both fronts! Seeing the HUD light up when you’re in the lead and have missiles bearing down on you from behind is a rush and helps you choose your lines more wisely than ever. Couldn’t be happier to announce its inclusion! Our next update will be when achievements are done but it’s very unlikely to be in a week so unfortunately it will break a streak of over 60 consecutive weeks of updates. Disappointing? Nahhhh. What a run of productivity!

Given ZEROED’s development should be wrapping up in the near future, we thought it’d be a good idea to finally update our game trailer to show off all the improvements since the previous one. We also used a lot more cinematic footage than last time, which we think makes it all the more appealing! Check it out and snag a copy while the Summer Sale is still on! In other news, we tightened up collisions so you can pass by other racers a lot closer without crashing. It’s making for a lot smoother racing! We’re wrapping up the incoming missile warning and let me tell ya… It’s looking real, real good. Hopefully you feel it adds as much to the experience as we do!

notes.title: Dat polish doe
notes.content:
[i]20210620[/i]
What’s good, gamers? Thinking of becoming a game developer? Know what they don’t tell you? That most of the time it’s not about adding cool and interesting features… Nope! Most of the time it’s about making what you’ve already implemented work properly! What fun! So we’re still wading through bugs but do you know how there used to be that big gap between the HUD and the rail? Well we tightened that up and you shouldn’t ever see a gap there again! Also, the loading bar is now your selected color instead of always blue. Nice touch, right? Last but certainly not least, we’re going to implement an incoming missile warning! It’s something we were unsure of before but it should throw a little more adrenaline into the mix!

You were able to race against a range of AI but you didn’t have the ability to tailor the experience beyond that. Well, now you can! notes.content:
[i]20210418[/i]
What’s good, gamers? The pre-race load screen is cleaned up and implemented! It turned out pretty much exactly as we’d hoped which isn’t always the case so we’re excited about it. Even further exceeding expectations is the leaderboard function! We’ve been wanting to include some sort of long-term goal and it looks like through Steam we’ll be able to track how many points everyone’s earned overall in ZeroHour. Not only that, but we’ll also track the best lap times for each track! We really wanted to do daily, weekly and monthly totals but sadly it doesn’t appear that can be automated, so it’s unlikely at this point. What we can add should be a nice touch, though!

notes.title: The three-step plan
notes.content:
[i]20201011[/i]
What’s good, gamers? Alright, everything’s lined up. We finally have the official game plan going forward to see whether or not this thing will sink or float. What is that, you ask? Can’t give specifics because Steam doesn’t allow us to but there are the typical 3 sales happening before the end of the year and we’re going to be in all 3 of those sales. The first one will be another small sale that we’re not going to expect too much from. The 2nd one will be a larger percentage off and when we’ll promote the game a bit. This is when we’re going to need to see some traction to know whether this is worth continuing to invest in. The 3rd sale will be our last-ditch effort to try and save things in case the 2nd sale didn’t do much. I really want to do everything we have planned for this game but funds are finite. We’ll see how it goes!
